Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_TimeBu: Stops starting new farming operations after this time. One operation can exceed the limit. Increase only if backlog persists and the server has spare processing time. Default: 2 ms.
Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_Adjust: Raises the plant-visit allowance only when unfinished work is not time-capped. Finishing with more than 10% of ticks to spare lowers it. Time-capped work adapts the sweep interval instead. Default: 5.
Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_MaxOpe: Maximum automatically tuned plant visits per tick. Each visit catches up elapsed game time; the time budget still applies. This is not a plant population limit. Default: 10000.
Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_MinUpd: Shortest background sweep interval. Rounded up to ten game minutes. Player interactions catch up synchronously. Default: 20.
Sandbox_ApocalypseBRFarmingSystem_MaxUpd: Longest adaptive background sweep interval under time-budget saturation. Rounded up to ten game minutes and never below the minimum. This does not guarantee a maximum simulation lag under sustained overload. Default: 60.
